The full record isfree with an accountor through the [API](https://indexed.vc/docs/api). ## About Trackforce is the physical security operations platform behind the people protecting organizations worldwide. It brings together TrackTik, GuardTek, and Silvertrac so thousands of customers can run security operations across more than 50 countries and 55 languages, from the guard on post to the boardroom. The platform supports scheduling, guard tours, incident reporting, billing, and enterprise back-office operations for security firms and corporate security teams. Today more than 4,600 customers run their operations on a single modern Trackforce platform. Summary It lists 201–500 employees.
